title: Marvel Super Heroes vs. Street Fighter CPS-2 Ryu vertical slice
purpose: Official-port research lane augmenting the AvP Saturn conversion

source.route: Two-player Ryu/Ken vs Spider-Man/Captain America; P2 remains neutral

workram_candidate_step_decreases.warning: Candidates are timing leads only; none is labeled health or damage until a writer/read path and actor ownership are proven.

claims.claim: The deterministic route reaches a native two-player match with Ryu active and a neutral Spider-Man target.
claims.test: Cold boot from blank state and replay the recorded inputs.
claims.falsification: Different active characters, an AI-controlled target, or a non-identical frame-1610 image hash.

claims.claim: The slice contains idle, forward walk, jump, standing light punch, Hadouken generation, projectile collision, and Spider-Man hit reaction in that order.
evidence: synchronized object RAM, work RAM, palette/register, and QSound streams
claims.test: Replay the route and require identical anchor hashes and contiguous evidence streams.
claims.falsification: An anchor hash changes, an action appears out of order, or P2 receives an input before the reaction.

remaining_uncertainty: Player and opponent actor-structure addresses are not yet mapped.
The exact health/damage field and collision-box records are not yet identified.
QSound register activity is captured but event-to-voice semantics are not yet decoded.
No CPS-2-to-Saturn correspondence is claimed until the same slice is captured on the official Saturn port.
rights_boundary: Raw captures and ROM data remain ignored private inputs; this tracked report contains hashes and derived measurements only.
